description: EU07 on td.scn on the td/rozklad timetable; at 10:35, as it leaves, the curve tdo_n222 about 950 m ahead buckles with a trackbuckle event (30 mm out of the curve, as the heat does: an equivalent radius of 330 m, too little to derail it). The track is laid again during the game and the train keeps on it to Przystanek.
